methodology.scope: Client-side planner calls including DB I/O and deserialization; excludes HTTP and connection setup.
methodology.load: Closed loop: each worker sends its next request after the previous one completes.
methodology.persistence: Redis AOF everysec; MongoDB standalone w:1,j:true. Durability is not equivalent.
methodology.failures: Any query error or parity mismatch aborts the run; no success report is written.

afterQueries.note: Memory is a whole-server snapshot including other namespaces, allocator and server overhead.
dataBytes is logical BSON; storage/index bytes are allocated disk; RSS includes the whole server.
